No refund. If you’re thinking about using this app, don’t. This app feels like a complete scam. They charge you without sending any email confirmation or transaction bill. When you try to cancel, they make the process intentionally confusing. The “Cancel” button is tiny and looks like normal text, while the big, highlighted “View” option tricks you into clicking it which ends up switching you to a yearly plan costing almost $150.
Even if you cancel the subscription and delete your account immediately after realizing the mistake, they still charge you. When I contacted support, this is the response I got:
“We appreciate you reaching out to Coursology Support. Upon checking, you have successfully changed your plan to the yearly plan before cancelling and deleting the account. Unfortunately, we do not offer refunds in accordance with Section 7 of our Terms of Use.”
So basically good luck if you want to give them free money. Their system is designed to mislead users and make canceling as difficult as possible. I’m sharing this so others don’t fall for the same trap

CAREFUL!!!. While the app itself is really friendly and easy to use, be careful with how they bill. They say they’ll cancel anytime, which is true, I was easily able to cancel the subscription after 1 month of use. Just decided it wasn’t worth continuing to use. After it was cancelled, they still tried to bill me monthly at the $25 per month the following month, they tried 3 different times to bill that following month. Then silence, nothing happened, then about 6 months later, I received notice from my card provider that said they tried to bill me for the yearly plan which was $174.93! So now I’m back on their website making sure I didn’t miss anything, nope, it’s been cancelled and I’ve followed all their information provided, so it is cancelled, they’re just still trying to bill which is outrageous. So now I’ve escalated it to their support to make sure they don’t keep trying to bill me. Luckily I put this on a specific debit card intentionally where I minimally use it or carry a balance, so no money has actually been charged to said card, but still, if it was a debit card where I keep a balance, I’d have just gotten charged for this service which I cancelled and didn’t use. Honestly, do yourself a favor and don’t get lured into this trap, it’s not worth it. Cool app, not that cool to experience this.
